d:
This time in Guest In The Newsroom, our guest is former Indian cricketer and ex-captain of the Indian women’s cricket team, Mithali Raj. With a remarkable career decorated with numerous world records, the Padma Shri, and the Khel Ratna award, Mithali opens up about the status of women in cricket, the controversies surrounding her, and much more.
Production: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Shakir/Ravi
